decks.notes: This UR Aggro deck focuses on quickly deploying threats like Murktide Regent and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer while disrupting the opponent's game plan with counter magic like Force of Will and Pyroblast. The deck also utilizes cantrips and card draw spells to dig for key cards and maintain tempo advantage. The mana base is optimized for consistent access to both red and blue mana sources, with utility lands like Strip Mine and Mystic Sanctuary to disrupt the opponent's mana base. Overall, this deck aims to apply pressure early and protect its threats to quickly close out games.

The main concept of this control deck is to use Oath of Druids as a key card to cheat out powerful creatures like Griselbrand or Hullbreaker Horror onto the battlefield. The deck also includes a variety of control cards like Force of Will, Flusterstorm, and Veil of Summer to protect your threats and disrupt your opponent's game plan. Additionally, there are cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Oko, Thief of Crowns to provide additional utility and disruption. The deck aims to control the game until it can successfully resolve Oath of Druids and overpower the opponent with its powerful creatures.

The deck focuses on controlling the opponent's actions through counterspells, removal spells, and disruptive creatures, while also utilizing powerful card draw and tutor effects to find key cards quickly. It aims to establish board presence with creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Sphinx of the Steel Wind, and uses cards like Bolas's Citadel and Time Vault for game-winning combos. The deck also leverages artifact mana acceleration and powerful planeswalkers like Narset, Parter of Veils and Dack Fayden to gain additional advantage and disrupt the opponent's strategy.

This deck focuses on using the Doomsday card to set up a winning combination of cards, with Thassa's Oracle as the finisher. The deck has a strong control element with counterspells like Force of Will and Flusterstorm, as well as disruption with Duress and Daze. The deck also includes powerful card draw and selection with cards like Ancestral Recall and Brainstorm. The mana base is optimized with fetch lands and dual lands, along with fast mana rocks like Black Lotus. The overall strategy is to control the game until setting up the Doomsday combo for victory.

The main concept of this deck is to use powerful control elements such as counterspells, artifact manipulation, and card draw to disrupt the opponent's game plan while setting up powerful win conditions like Time Vault or Urza, Lord High Artificer. The deck aims to control the game tempo, generate card advantage, and ultimately secure victory through efficient and versatile spells. Additionally, it utilizes a combination of artifact mana, land acceleration, and card selection to maximize its efficiency and consistency in executing its control strategy.

The deck aims to control the game by utilizing powerful tutors, counterspells, and card draw to disrupt the opponent's strategy while setting up its own win conditions. It includes powerful combo pieces like Time Vault and Bolas's Citadel to generate advantage and eventually win the game. The deck also includes strong planeswalkers like Narset, Parter of Veils and efficient removal like Swords to Plowshares. It combines artifact ramp with powerful blue spells to control the game and outvalue the opponent. The deck's focus is on resource management and incremental advantage to secure victory.

The deck focuses on utilizing the powerful card Underworld Breach to create a combo that can quickly overwhelm the opponent. The deck includes numerous ways to manipulate the graveyard and draw cards to find the combo pieces quickly. It also includes protection in the form of counterspells and removal spells to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The key strategy is to assemble the combo pieces, cast Underworld Breach, and generate a large storm count to activate Brain Freeze multiple times in a single turn, milling the opponent's library and winning the game.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of counterspells, card draw, and disruptive artifacts. It aims to generate card advantage and prevent the opponent from executing their game plan effectively. The deck includes powerful spells like Ancestral Recall and Time Walk, along with mana acceleration from Moxen and Sol Ring. It also utilizes disruptive creatures like Hullbreacher and Lavinia to disrupt the opponent's mana base and resource development. With efficient removal and counter magic, the deck aims to establish a dominant position and win through incremental advantage.
